The Penny Hoarder is one of the world's largest personal finance websites with 16+ million monthly readers. We help millions of readers worldwide earn and save money by sharing unique job opportunities, personal stories, freebies and more. In 2017, Inc. 5000 ranked The Penny Hoarder as the No. 1 fastest-growing private media company in the U.S. for the second consecutive year, and #25 on the overall list of the fastest-growing private companies in America.

We believe personal finance shouldn’t be taboo. We get people talking about earning and saving money by creating compelling, engaging multimedia content that makes the topic fun, accessible and shareable.

Finally, we pay it forward by giving back, from our annual college scholarship to our regular giveaways. We recently surprised 48 of our readers with nearly $30,000 in dream gifts.

Our goal is to improve the lives of everyday folks by helping them spend less time worrying about their finances and more time enjoying their lives.
